# Complete Knowledge Base & Profile: Muhammed - UI/UX Designer & Front-End Developer

## Executive Overview
Muhammed is a multidisciplinary UI/UX Designer and Front-End Developer based in Kochi, Kerala, India, available for clients and product teams worldwide. He specializes in designing intuitive digital products, component-driven design systems, and building sub-second high-performance React web applications.

---

## Detailed Professional Expertise

### 1. UI/UX Design & Product Strategy
- **User Interface (UI) Design**: Clean, modern visual hierarchy, cohesive color palettes, typography scales, pixel-perfect alignment, and dark/light design modes.
- **User Experience (UX) Architecture**: User journey mapping, wireframing, interactive prototyping, usability testing, and frictionless conversion funnels.
- **Design Systems**: Building scalable component libraries in Figma, defining design tokens (colors, spacing, typography, motion curves), and facilitating seamless design-to-code developer handoff.

### 2. Front-End Web Engineering
- **React.js & Modern JavaScript**: State management, component modularity, custom hooks, dynamic routing, and fast initial rendering.
- **Modern Styling (HTML5 / SCSS / CSS3)**: Responsive layouts using CSS Grid & Flexbox, custom design tokens, sub-millisecond styling computations, and cross-browser consistency.
- **Animations & Micro-Interactions**: GSAP (GreenSock Animation Platform), Lenis smooth scrolling, scroll-triggered animations, hover states, and smooth modal transitions.
- **Performance Optimization**: Image lazy loading, asset compression, preconnecting external fonts, code-splitting, and Core Web Vitals optimization (LCP, FID, CLS).

## Case Study Breakdown

### Case Study 1: Voyagera Travel Platform
- **Title**: Voyagera - World Expeditions & Luxury Havens
- **Category**: Travel & Hospitality
- **Role**: Lead UI/UX Designer & Front-End Developer
- **Tech Stack**: Figma, React, SCSS, Motion, Vercel
- **URL**: https://muhammed.dev/case-study/voyagera
- **Overview**: A luxury travel expedition platform engineered to connect global explorers with handpicked luxury retreats. Balanced rich photography with crisp typography and smooth filtering workflows.
- **Results**: 99+ PageSpeed score, +45% session time increase, 2.4x booking conversion.

- **Results**: Sub-second page loads, intuitive slide-out cart drawers, mobile-first design.

### Case Study 3: Elve Mobility & Rental Platform

### Case Study 4: Green Track Sustainability Dashboard

- **Results**: Streamlined ESG compliance reporting for enterprise clients.
